featured_reviews.name: Jon-Paul Lindsey
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Kalakar Tattoo and Art World recently and had a tattoo drawn by Akshaya. The majority of my tattoos are last minute ‘walk ins’, and I’ve had many from around the globe. Being ‘last minute’ the quality of the tattoos are usually sacrificed and it’s understandably difficult to fully connect with the tattooist as you only have a brief time to discuss, negotiate and agree etc. This was entirely the opposite case with Akshaya. From the moment I walked in, I felt extremely comfortable and within minutes we were discussing all the various options for the vague idea I had for my piece. Akshaya isn’t just a fantastic and patient listener; she’s a true artist in every sense of the word. I’m beyond elated with the finished work- she’s incredibly knowledgable, intuitive, caring and her soft touch with the gun is exceptional. The final piece is one of my most favourite and by far the very best I’ve had from a simple ‘walk in’. I cannot recommend her and her inherent skills more and can’t wait to get back to Goa so I can have and her genius mind do another piece for me. 10 stars, simply exceptional.
